In the event of not specifying these two factors, it is very likely to occur when crossing a bridge or tunnel due to the size of the barrel too large, too high, causing the car to get stuck causing trouble in the process of engaging in traffic.

Vì chiều dài và kích thước container 40.en: Since the length and size of the container 40 feet is very large, the turn radius is very wide. So you shouldn't be too surprised at the cases where the car is on the left but you stick to the right side of the road. If you don't understand traffic, it's certainly extremely dangerous to die when you choose to run your car into the empty spaces next to the container head.
Vì chiều dài và kích thước container 40.zh: 由于集装箱40英尺的长度和大小非常大,转弯半径非常宽. 所以你不应该太惊讶 汽车在左边的情况 但你坚持在路的右边。 如果你不懂交通,那么当你选择把车开进集装箱头旁边的空位时,死亡无疑是极其危险的.
